events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit, push and helper state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git status --short -- cloud/src/util.ts app/scripts/probe-calendar-feeds.mjs; git log --oneline -3 -- cloud/src/util.ts; git fetch -q origin; git merge-base --is-ancestor 51c7ee1 origin/main && echo "51c7ee1 on origin"; git merge-base --is-ancestor 51c7ee1 97096ab && echo "in 97096ab"; git log -1 --oneline origin/main; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; grep -n "example" cloud/src/util.ts | head

events.text: Committed and on origin. Next I'll check which Worker version is live and whether it was built from a commit that contains 51c7ee1.

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; npx wrangler deployments list 2>/dev/null | tail -25; for c in 95d8630e 97096ab; do git merge-base --is-ancestor 51c7ee1 $c 2>/dev/null && echo "$c contains fix"; done

events.text: Several deploys since 97096ab (latest 9761eae3), all from bases that contain the fix. A behavioural check on production is the real proof, so next I'll look up the admin auth and the request shapes.
